methodology.Revenue: Protocol cut of pack fees, redemption-fee skims and zap fees, all accruing to the treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue: the treasury's cut of pack fees, redemption skims and zap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: $FWS buybacks funded from the protocol's buyback share and from liquidated redemption skims (burned or redistributed).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Depositors' net take from pack sales (their pro-rata share of the gross price minus the fair value of the lots forfeited), plus the Corner Office pot paid to the top-backed lot's depositor.

Fees.Pack Fees: The 10% protocol surcharge over the quoted expected value on settled Pack draws, net of the surcharge slice rebated to purchasers as $FWS allowances.
Fees.Redemption Fees: Stock tokens skimmed (redeemFeeBps, 5% at launch, snapshotted per Pack) when a winner claims, relists or swaps out a won lot.
Fees.Zap Fees: 1% zap fee on ETH entering via zap-in plus 1% swap fee on stock exits to ETH.

Revenue.Pack Fees: Protocol cut (1%) of pack fees, sent to the treasury.
Revenue.Redemption Fees: Redemption skims accrue to the protocol and are later liquidated into $FWS buy-and-burns.
Revenue.Zap Fees: Zap and swap fees accrue to the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Pack Fees: Depositors' net take: the pro-rata pack-price distribution across active Lots minus the fair value of the drawn lots forfeited. Can be negative in idle periods when the full surcharge is rebated to the purchaser.
SupplySideRevenue.Corner Office Pot: 2.5% of each pack fee accruing to the depositor of the top-backed lot (the Corner Office).

HoldersRevenue.Token Buybacks: $FWS buybacks: the scheduled buyback (40/40/20 split across depositors, purchasers and burn) plus buy-and-burns funded by liquidated redemption skims.

methodology.HoldersRevenue: All swap fees are allocated to veSTONX voters in proportion to the voting power assigned to each pool.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Zero. Liquidity providers receive STONX emissions rather than a share of swap fees.
methodology.Volume: Input-token volume from swaps across every Ekubo Core pool configured with the deployed STONX Ve33 extension on Robinhood Chain. Only the input side of each swap is counted.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders only. External bribes are deposited by third parties to influence votes, so they are excluded here even though they count towards Fees.
methodology.Fees: Per-pool swap fee read from PoolFactory.getFee (default vAMM 0.30% / sAMM 0.05%, customizable per pool) applied to each swap, plus external bribes deposited by third parties to voter-incentive contracts.
methodology.Revenue: veRAPH voters’ take: staked-LP swap fees forwarded to voters plus external bribes. Equals HoldersRevenue — Raphael keeps no treasury cut of swap fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Swap fees from staked LPs (fee × pool.balanceOf(gauge) / pool.totalSupply), forwarded to veRAPH voters, plus external bribes.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees kept by unstaked LPs (fee × (1 − stakedShare)). LPs who stake in the gauge forgo these fees in exchange for RAPH emissions.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume across Raphael Exchange (non-CL) pools, counted once per swap from the core-asset side.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, per-pool rate from PoolFactory.getFee applied to each swap amount.
Fees.External Bribes Rewards: External incentives deposited by third parties to the voter bribe/incentive contracts (NotifyReward events).

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, per-pool rate from PoolFactory.getFee applied to each swap amount.

Revenue.Staked-LP Swap Fees: Staked-LP share of swap fees, forwarded to veRAPH voters.
Revenue.External Bribes Revenue: External incentives deposited by third parties, claimable by veRAPH voters.

HoldersRevenue.Staked-LP Swap Fees: Staked-LP share of swap fees, forwarded to veRAPH voters.
HoldersRevenue.External Bribes Revenue: External incentives deposited by third parties, claimable by veRAPH voters.
